snippet.title: Sonic Terror - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Book Burner Games is thrilled to announce Sonic Terror, a turn-based tactical RPG where music is brutal magic and the only weapon against a space alien parasite that has turned silence into new law.

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4123810/Sonic_Terror 

Set in an alternative 1984, Sonic Terror puts you in control of an outlaw rock band on tour  through a totalitarian Republic invaded by body-snatching aliens. The only thing they’re afraid of is music - and you’re the last ones to play it.
